title: Nothing you can see changed: the 1965 porch photograph's puzzle narrowed
items: Nothing you can see changed. The 1965 colour slide draws 1808 Prairie's porch about a third taller than the model. We tested the explanations one at a time: a tilted camera, a distorting lens, a mis-measured bay window, and the porch standing somewhere else. None of them fits. A second photograph, Richard Nickel's from 1967, draws the porch taller by the same amount. So the question left for the Keith house's photo check is narrower: are the porch's columns taller than the model built them from the 1888 magazine plate?
